scope: Metadata only; no model download, synthesis, reservation or training admission.

known_same_reader.constraint: One physical-reader role; cannot count as independent voices or split between training and heldout.

compatibility: Not certified against existing manual phoneme/token generator. hifi_tts_92 explicitly merges diphthong IDs; do not substitute models without config/token and waveform quality certification.
limits: 31 catalog families are not 31 independent physical voices.
Shared finetuning ancestor does not by itself prove same target reader; retain ancestry as a separate dependence limitation.
Current exact-name tracked metadata search does not clear aliases or all historical branches.
Existing 672 conditioning IDs belong to the authenticated old checkpoint; no ID mapping to a newly downloaded model is implied.
